zones.title: Kitchen
zones.role: Prepare the gathered food. Six station proxies face a 6 m clear central aisle. The kitchen opens through one 8 m threshold into the arrival court.

zones.title: Arrival court
zones.role: Orient around the basin and choose a bank. Both 8 m side openings stay visible. This is the shared return space, with no scattered ingredients.

zones.title: Root court
zones.role: Harvest on the protected west edge; encounter proxy controls the approach. An 8 m stair climbs directly to the upper gallery. No empty basement or ladder.

zones.title: Hunt court
zones.role: Open encounter space with a guarded protein pickup on a low plinth. The opposite stair makes this a through-route, rather than a dead-end arena.

zones.title: Upper stores
zones.role: A purposeful upper destination for seasoning. Connected west to east at one continuous +4 m datum; the outer loop always works even when bridge gates are closed.

zones.title: Puzzle bridge
zones.role: A clear cross-basin shortcut. Drop the pack on the west plate and stand on the second plate to latch the west gate. Either chain opens the east timed gate for 8 seconds.
